Name: Jigsaw Puzzle
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[youtube]dMIiZ__LguI[/youtube]

You can buy the jigsaw puzzle box from Pierre's. Placing it on any table lets you open the puzzle interface.


[b][size=5]Features
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]By default, when a piece is dropped within one tile distance from a piece it should connect to, it snaps to that piece.
[*]You can zoom with the scroll wheel, and drag the entire puzzle interface with the mouse.
[*]You can edit the list of available music in the config. There is a stop/play button and a next button for the music.
[*]All in-game maps are added to the Map drop down, including modded maps.
[*]Animated tiles animate and tiles change based on the current or selected season.
[*]You can toggle snapping to tile grid by pressing the toggle key (default Left Shift).
[*]You can cause a puzzle to solve itself by pressing the solve key (default End).
[*]Puzzle data is saved per-box, so you can leave a puzzle and come back later to continue it.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Notes
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Zoom and drag are constrained by the mod to what seem like reasonable values.
[*]Selecting a piece size makes the mod determine the closest possible piece size where all pieces can be either that size or one less, so you'll notice that it adjusts the piece size after you select it. Size refers to width and height in tiles.
[*]Puzzle box behaviour in multiplayer won't be perfect, you can't really work on the same puzzle as someone else at the same time.
[*]This game is compatible with an upcoming "Stardew Games" mod, that lets you access minigames from the main menu.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Config
[/size][/b]
This mod implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] menu for in-game config editing.
